proof_attempt_summary: Two D0 solver rounds established the moving-median density exponent alpha=min(beta,2beta/(2beta+1)), matching sequential and frozen cumulative influence-variance regret orders, the optimal pilot order, and uniform feasible inference for both attaining designs. Main resolved two source-access blocks through primary-source attestations; the final mathematical referee passed with no findings, but the authoritative below-field score ceiling6.8<7.4 and unresolved Falk/Welsh theorem-level priority led to downgraded banking after independent D and main validity checks. No F-stage, Lean proof, terminal-QTE minimax theorem, finite-horizon performance calibration, substrate promotion or presentation was attempted.
tldr: Over the stipulated compact-support positive Holder class, learning density at an unknown median has squared-risk exponent \(\alpha_\beta=\min\{\beta,2\beta/(2\beta+1)\}\). Matching lower bounds and observable policies give chronological cumulative influence-variance regret of order \(n^{-\alpha_\beta}\) for all predictable designs and \(n^{-\alpha_\beta/(1+\alpha_\beta)}\) for one frozen update, attained by pilot lengths \(m_n\asymp n^{1/(1+\alpha_\beta)}\). The transition is at \(\beta=1/2\), with no boundary logarithm. Weighted medians with terminal retained-density studentization have a law-uniform normal limit and nominal 95 percent asymptotic coverage under both attaining designs; the frozen inference application also holds for every deterministic \(m_n\to\infty\), \(m_n/n\to0\). These are results for the exact maintained class and cumulative criterion. The Li--Luo--Wang--Feng CARA class differs from this class, and the oracle map is a no-covariate specialization. Pooled terminal pilot compensation remains possible; historical priority of the moving-functional phase remains conditional on access to the unverified predecessor theorem texts.
gap: First-order oracle efficiency leaves the sample cost of learning unknown median densities unresolved. Smooth sparsity expansions do not justify ignoring median displacement on the full stipulated rough class.
fill: Characterize the unknown-location functional, prove lower bounds over the complete declared decision classes, and construct observable attaining designs. Supporting law-uniform weighted-median inversion and feasible studentization validate median-effect reporting under the attaining design.
